title: Write release notes in ACME house style

sessions.prompt: changes.json describes the next release. Write RELEASE_NOTES.md in ACME house style for it. Reply briefly when done.

graders.label: clarity & accuracy
graders.rubric:
1. Every change from changes.json appears exactly once, under the right section (features → Highlights, fixes → Fixes, breaking → Breaking changes).
2. Each item is rewritten for end users (what changed for them), not copied as an internal ticket title.
3. The breaking change explains what users must do (grant/require the reports:read scope).
4. No invented changes, versions or dates.
5. Concise: one line per item.
graders.reference: Highlights: bulk-approve expenses from review queue (ACME-790); dark mode on mobile (ACME-799). Fixes (ascending ticket): rounding in multi-currency invoices (ACME-755); CSV export last row (ACME-812). Breaking: /v1/reports requires reports:read scope (ACME-801) — clients must request the scope.
